senses.gloss: [to heat,] to make כּוֹמֶר (v. כּוֹמֶר I), to produce shrinking and maturing of fruits by underground storage or by exposure to the sun.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 9:10">Tosef. Men. IX, 10</cite> <he>לא היו … וכוֹמְרִין אותן</he> (Var. <he>וכורמין</he>) they did not cut the grapes and let them shrink (before putting them in the press), but cut and immediately pressed them.
B. Mets. 89ᵇ ולא יִכְמוֹר באדמה וכ׳ (Ar. יְכַמֵּר Pi., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) the laborer must not hide grapes in the ground (to eat them afterwards).
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:1">Maasr. IV, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00807"><he>כָּמַן</he></cite>. B. Mets. l. c., v. supra.

senses.gloss: (denom. of מִכְמָר) to lay a trap, net.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 14:6">Tosef. Yeb. XIV, 6</cite> <he>שהיו מְכַמְּרִין מכמרות</he> that were laying nets; <cite ref="Yevamot 121a">Yeb. 121ᵃ</cite> <he>מְכַ׳ מכמורין</he>; Y. ib. XVI, 15ᵈ top <he>לִכְמוֹר מ׳</he>.

senses.gloss: to shrink, fall in by the effect of the heat, to tumble inward. Y. B. Mets. X, beg. 12ᶜ נ׳ כתנור if the house fell in like a furnace, opp. נפל לחוץ.
(trnsf.) with רחמים, to be bent over, to feel compassion (cmp. גִּלְגֵּל).
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 150:1">Yalk. Gen. 150</cite> <he>נִכְמְרוּ רחמיו של יוסף</he> Joseph was moved to compassion; (Tanḥ. Vayigg. 4 <he>נתגלגלו ר׳</he>).
